metadata.title: Incident Response Retainer | Zion Tech Group

values: If this guide matches your incident response retainer initiative, the next step is a scoping call with Zion Tech Group. We will define one measurable outcome, identify dependencies, and outline a pilot plan you can start in days. Contact us to move from assessment to execution with a timeline and success criteria already in place.
